theme: An open Saturday with a concert at its center.
greeting: A quiet off-week Saturday, mostly open. The Black Keys at the State Theatre anchor the afternoon and the rest of the day is yours — a good window to clear the travel bookings that have been waiting.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Your one p1 in Dan & Mike Stuff, overdue since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market — hold a refundable booking now and fix the dates later.

needsAttention.title: December break — decide, then book
needsAttention.detail: p2, slipped past the Sept 30 decision date. All four girls, six travelers, three weeks over the holidays; the plan was book by Oct 15. The real call is domestic vs. international, and passports won't be in hand by booking day.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike, 9 AM
needsAttention.detail: On tomorrow's calendar. Three travel items are the ones slipping — the Christmas rental, the December trip, and the Pathfinder drive; arriving with those three triaged is essentially the agenda.

flagged.title: Lunch with Fran, next Friday
flagged.detail: She's in and fine with sushi; you floated Miyake or Isa Bistro — it just needs the spot and time locked.

flagged.title: DIRA & DIBA meeting packet
flagged.detail: David Wetherbee sent the materials for the Oct 25 meeting. Nothing owed now — a read before the date.

inbox.noise: The rest is the usual weekend quiet — promotions and updates, nothing pressing.
inbox.clear: No unread mail is waiting on a reply this morning.

recipe.title: Quinces Poached in Muscat
recipe.why: Quince comes into its own in autumn, and a slow poach in sweet wine is the season at its most fragrant.
